week-2-section.label: Week 2 Section
week-2-section.summary: This source provides a comprehensive review of the history of Silicon Valley, detailing the five key pillars that fostered its growth. It traces the region's evolution from agricultural land to a global tech powerhouse driven by government funding, academic innovation, venture capital, immigration, and specific legal frameworks.

week-3-section.label: Week 3 Section
week-3-section.summary: This source outlines the logistics and requirements for the Team Start-Up Competition in POLECON 156, focusing heavily on the process of selecting a startup and conducting a founder interview. It details deadlines, team roles, and strategies for reaching out to founders in the Silicon Valley ecosystem.
week-3-section.note: Slides 4-5 of the original deck (team rosters with student names) were removed before adding it to this public repo (student privacy / FERPA). Slide numbers here refer to the redacted file.

week-4-reflection.label: Week 4 Reflection
week-4-reflection.summary: This source is a reflection prompt for Week 4, requiring students to answer questions about early online retail challenges and the motivations behind the creation of Google.

week-5-section.label: Week 5 Section
week-5-section.summary: This source provides logistical information about the upcoming midterm exam and outlines key themes from the course readings. It also offers advice on building a professional profile and practicing essay writing skills.
